entry_rationale: Receive MX CRAH27 / CORRA_2027-03 at the packet implied 3.13. That is the first 2027 three-month contract that prices a Canadian hiking cycle (+84bp vs CORRA cash 2.29) after 1m CORRA still only reaches 2.58 by Dec-2026 and Dec-26 3m CRAZ26 is 2.775. August labor (-42k, wages +2.0%) and CPI-trim/median 1.9/2.0 do not support delivering that 2027 path. Side long is duration-long in implied-rate space (profits if the 3.13 implied falls toward the still-alive near-term path).

Close the Canada March receive. The freeze is 2.965 versus a 3.13 entry, so the line is still through entry, but today's 41.5 basis point jump is larger than the 16.5 basis points left back to that entry. March funding futures rose 61.5 basis points and September rose 78. The residual is smaller than the session that just printed, so the receive comes off and no new rates ticket is added.

invalidation: Thesis fails if BoC hikes or the 1m CORRA strip through Dec-2026 reprices toward the 2027 CRA mid-3s; if CPI-trim/median leave the 1.9/2.0 zone higher while employment stops contracting and wages re-accelerate; or if CORRA_2027-03 implied holds at or above the 3.13 entry because catch-up is actually being delivered. A US-only or energy-headline move that leaves CRAH27 unchanged is not invalidation. Wrong timing, not wrong thesis, if implieds chop around 3.13 without a new BoC hike signal.
